metadata.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
metadata.params_total: 552B backbone + 196B Engram (linked V4.1 family report; the 1017 config is identical to the September checkpoint)
metadata.params_active: 8B prefill / 16B decode (linked V4.1 family architecture report; unchanged 1017 config)
metadata.variant_policy: October 17 minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with one image+text checkpoint, chat/thinking modes and continuous numeric reasoning effort. Current config is structurally identical to the September pinned config. The new release specifically discloses self-feedback RL and improved reasoning, coding, agentic and visual results with shorter output and task time; it does not publish a separate 1017 technical report or training budget. The model card links the earlier V4.1 report for architecture background.

backbone.context_window_notes: config.json max_position_embeddings=1048576 (1M tokens). Training curriculum for this dated checkpoint is not disclosed.

context_extension.notes: Config-declared YaRN; this does not establish a current-checkpoint pre-training curriculum.

variants.name: sliding_window_attention
variants.notes: 128-token layer-local window in every layer; layers 0-1 are SWA only.

variants.name: csa2_full
variants.notes: Computes shared global KV and indexer keys; layers 2,8,14,20.

variants.name: csa2_reindex
variants.notes: Reuses global KV/indexer keys but computes fresh top-512; layers 24,28,32,36.

variants.name: csa2_reuse
variants.notes: Reuses preceding global KV and top-k; remaining 30 global-attention layers.

attention.layer_pattern: 40 backbone layers: 0-1 SWA only; 2-19 encoder CSA2 with ratio 2 and [Full, Reuse×5] repeated three times; 20-39 decoder ratio 1 with Full at 20, Reindex at 24/28/32/36 and Reuse otherwise. All layers retain local SWA. Current config matches the linked family report topology.

sparse_attention.selection: Full/Reindex layers score indexer keys projected from shared main KV; Reuse layers inherit top-512 indices. Layer 20 builds a candidate pool of top 2048 blocks × 8 positions (at most 16384 positions); decoder Reindex layers select within that pool (config + reference Indexer).
sparse_attention.notes: Shapes and sharing topology from current config and reference code; the family report is earlier architecture background.

cross_layer_sharing.notes: Linked family report: decoder global KV is projected from final encoder output; under CSA2, Full layer 20 materializes it for decoder reuse. The minimal current reference runs the full stack and does not implement the optimized encoder-only prefill schedule.

cross_layer_sharing.consumer_layers: All other global-attention layers read the most recent Full layer state.
cross_layer_sharing.notes: Current config kv_source_layer_ids and reference SharedAttentionRuntime.

cross_layer_sharing.consumer_layers: The other 30 global-attention layers reuse the most recent index-source top-k.
cross_layer_sharing.notes: Current config index_source_layer_ids; candidate_source_layer_id=20 is an additional shared search-domain restriction.

attention.notes: Current config: query low-rank projection 1280; grouped output projection 8 groups × rank 1024; partial RoPE width 64 of 512.

moe.routing: Current config: top-6 routed experts + 1 shared expert; SqrtSoftplus affinity (scoring_func=sqrtsoftplus); topk_method=noaux_tc; norm_topk_prob=true; routed_scaling_factor=1.5. Reference Gate uses correction biases for selection and unbiased scores for output weights. Current Gate has separate text/image selection biases (bias and bias_vl).

ffn.layer_partition: All backbone blocks instantiate MoE FFNs in inference/model.py.

components.activation: SwiGLU (hidden_act=silu), swiglu_limit=10.0 in current config and reference Expert.
components.normalization: RMSNorm, rms_norm_eps=1e-20; separate hc_eps=1e-06 for Hyper-Connections.
components.embedding_notes: vocab_size=129280; tie_word_embeddings=false. Image positions are replaced by visual embeddings in the reference Transformer.

residual_connections.constraint: Doubly stochastic residual mixing via Sinkhorn normalization in the current reference implementation.

auxiliary_modules.name: DSpark draft module
auxiliary_modules.architecture: 3 draft blocks (reference inference/config.json n_mtp_layers=3), window-only attention; block_size=5; Markov rank 256; target layers [37, 38, 39].
auxiliary_modules.notes: The reference Transformer constructs DSparkBlock modules when dspark_block_size is nonzero; this does not establish an MTP training objective.

memory_modules.name: Engram conditional memory
memory_modules.params: 196B (linked V4.1 family report; current table dimensions imply 196.614B embedding elements before projections)
memory_modules.addressing: Current config and inference/engram.py: n-gram orders 2,3,4 with 8 hash heads per order over tokenizer-compressed IDs; text only, image tokens masked.
memory_modules.table_config: engram_num_embeddings=[384006168,384016682]; head_dim=256; compressed vocab=99092; base vocab per hash=16000000. Current Engram projects retrieved vectors to per-HC-copy keys plus shared values and gates the update.
memory_modules.storage: Current inference ParallelEngramEmbedding uses FP8 embedding weights. Production offload policy for the 1017 release is not separately specified.
memory_modules.notes: Forward-pass memory, separate from the DSpark draft. This entry does not import September optimizer or learning-rate claims.

architecture.parallelism_notes: Only inference topology is documented here; current-checkpoint training parallelism is undisclosed. Reference inference supports tensor-parallel torchrun and checkpoint conversion.

training.data_mix_notes: The current release does not disclose training-token counts or mixture fractions. Earlier family reports are not evidence for the dated update training budget.

alignment.rl_method: Reinforcement learning with self-feedback (official 2026-10-17 release note). The update does not name an RL algorithm or specify reward, feedback-label generation, or training budget.

stages.name: Self-feedback reinforcement learning
stages.description: Official release note attributes stronger end-to-end project development (game creation and 3D modeling) to self-feedback RL. Ordering relative to other training stages and implementation details are undisclosed.

inference_modes.name: thinking-low
inference_modes.description: Reasoning effort selected by the current prompt encoder.

inference_modes.name: thinking-high
inference_modes.description: Reasoning effort selected by the current prompt encoder.

inference_modes.name: thinking-max
inference_modes.description: Reasoning effort selected by the current prompt encoder.

inference_modes.name: chat
inference_modes.description: Places </think> after the assistant prefix to skip reasoning.

levels.name: low
levels.rendering: <｜System｜>Reasoning Effort: 50 (range 1-100, the higher the value, the more thorough the reasoning)

levels.name: high
levels.rendering: <｜System｜>Reasoning Effort: 75 (range 1-100, the higher the value, the more thorough the reasoning)

levels.name: max
levels.rendering: <｜System｜>Reasoning Effort: 100 (range 1-100, the higher the value, the more thorough the reasoning)

reasoning_effort.applies_when: thinking_mode=thinking; prefix inserted at conversation index 0 before the system text.
reasoning_effort.invalid_value_behavior: Reference render_reasoning_effort asserts: only exact Python ints within 1-100 or low/high/max aliases are accepted; None selects high. Validation runs even when the prefix is not rendered.
reasoning_effort.notes: Current encoding.py and encoding/README.md. The September report describes effort-conditioned RL, but the 1017 update does not restate its training method.

tool_call_protocol.arguments_schema: <｜DSML｜ invoke name="..."> with per-argument <｜DSML｜ parameter name="..." string="true|false">; raw strings or JSON for non-strings.
tool_call_protocol.notes: Current encoding supports namespace::function; leading spaces in V4.1 DSML tags differ from V4. No published production parser flag in the current model card.

quantization.scope: FP4 routed-expert weights; FP8 quantization configuration for other quantized weights. This is a deployment format, not proof of the current training precision.
quantization.notes: Current config uses quant_method=fp8 together with expert_dtype=fp4. The dated checkpoint does not disclose a new quantization training recipe.

training.stability_notes: Current config/reference Expert clamps SwiGLU activations at 10. The update does not disclose loss-spike handling or a full training-stability recipe.

multimodal.fusion_notes: Linked V4.1 family report describes multimodal training from the start; current 1017 code retains the same architecture. Current inference/vision.py: 3×3 spatial merging followed by two linear aligner layers with GELU; projected image features replace image positions in the shared LM stream.

vision_encoder.architecture: DeepSeek ViT with full bidirectional attention, 2D RoPE, linear RGB patch embedding, RMSNorm and SwiGLU (current inference/vision.py)
vision_encoder.notes: max image tokens=1024; min pixels=295936; max width/height ratio=None. No video/audio path disclosed.

open_questions: 1017 optimizer, LR schedule, update-token budget, data mixture, SFT/distillation and exact RL algorithm are undisclosed; do not carry over September Muon/45T/GRPO/OPD claims.
Self-feedback RL does not disclose whether AI generates preference labels; rlaif remains UNKNOWN.

Parameter figures are architecture-level figures from the linked September report; no separate 1017 accounting is published. HF safetensors element totals include packed/quantized and auxiliary tensors and are not substituted for paper parameter counts.

The minimal reference executes all 40 backbone blocks for prefill; encoder-only prefill, SWA bounded replay and production cache performance are described by the linked family report, not benchmarked for 1017.
